name: Or Tuma
description: Or Tuma was the outermost planet orbiting the star Ryloth in the Ryloth system. It was a frozen rock located in the Outer Rim Territories.
lead_paragraphs: Or Tuma was the outermost planet orbiting the star Ryloth in the Ryloth system. It was a frozen rock located in the Outer Rim Territories.
A small colony of Twi'leks settled the planet in an attempt to get away from the scorching hot temperatures of Ryloth.
